exercises.q: What problem did Lucie have?
exercises.a: She rarely had a day off.
options: She rarely had a day off.
exercises.text: Lucie works in a busy restaurant. She earns a good salary, but she often does overtime and rarely has a day off. Last month she made a big decision: she asked her boss if she could work four days a week instead of five. She knew that she would earn less, but she wanted to spend more time with her family. To her surprise, her boss agreed. Now Lucie is less tired and she has time to do the things she enjoys, like gardening and baking.

exercises.q: Where was the backpack found?
exercises.text: Lost and found: Yesterday afternoon someone left a black backpack on the number 22 tram. Inside there is a laptop, a blue umbrella and a library book. If the backpack is yours, please come to the lost property office at the main station. You will need to describe the contents and show some ID. The office is open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on weekdays. Items which are not collected within three months will be given to charity.
